sentences.text: This miscellaneous appeal, under section 71(6) of Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 (for short "FSSA") has been filed against the judgment dated 5/3/2025 passed by IX District Judge, Gwalior in RCA No. 39/2025, as well as, order dated 28/11/2024 passed by Adjudicating Officer/ Additional District Magistrate, Gwalior in case No. Q/Food Safety/ 174/2023.

2. Facts necessary for disposal of present appeal, in short, are that a complaint was filed against appellant on the allegation that on 18/7/2023, the dairy belonging to appellant was inspected and sample of loose curd and loose milk-mix was collected.
The curd was found to be of substandard quality.

Copy of report of the Food Analyst was sent to the appellant with an information that he can file an appeal under section 46(4) of FSSA and under rule 2.4.2(6) of Food Safety and Standard Rules, 2011 but no appeal was filed.

3. The Adjudicating Officer after conducting the inquiry found that the lose curd was of substandard quality and held that appellant has violated section NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:30977 2 MSA-19-2025 26 read with section 51 of FSSA and imposed a penalty of Rs.1,00,000/-.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Being aggrieved by the order passed by the Adjudicating Officer, appellant filed an appeal which too has been dismissed by IX District Judge, Gwalior in RCA No.39/2025.
However, the penalty amount has been reduced to Rs. 50,000/-.
5. A solitary ground has been raised by counsel for appellant that penalty amount may be further reduced.
6. Sale of substandard food articles is detrimental to the mankind.
The appellant could not point out any exceptional circumstance requiring further reduction in the penalty amount.
The appellate Authority has already shown sufficient leniency to the appellant while adjudicating the quantum of penalty.

Accordingly, this Court is of considered opinion that since 25 kg of curd which was stored by the appellant for sale was found to be of substandard quality, therefore no case is made out warranting interference.
7. Appeal fails and is, hereby, dismissed.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE (and)
